versions.changelog:
- Skill revised to improve ChanLun (缠论) technical analysis for A股、港股、美股 with enhanced separation of processed and raw K-line data.
- Fixes prior errors where processed K-line data could become misaligned with raw data.
- Adds detailed explanations of key ChanLun concepts (fractal, stroke, segment, pivot, divergence).
- Output includes: Markdown report (core conclusions first), required visualization chart (K-line, strokes, pivots, MACD, volume), and JSON data summary.
- Strictly uses Tencent API data (excludes Beijing Stock Exchange).
- Clarifies all usage methods, output files, environment, and necessary Python dependencies.
